My entrance is through sleep, normal sleep, then awake through dream, if u can dream u in spirit world when u manage to be in control always then u awake from dream that's difference between dreaming and entering spirit world,it's just matter of degree of control to ur actions en choices plus sense of self, dream is like 0 to 10% percent control spirit world u will start feeling at 40% but at 60 upwards then u just know u unto something at this point u long realized that spirit world is home.

Yes u will see dreaming people around u when u manage to awake to 80 percent en above then again now u just need someone to guide u, no need to care of percent or anything so long someone who been there is there guides u, is like being given shortcut, that doesn't mean it be easy it meant u won't be too blind on ur pursuit.

Evert has to access spirit world en awake to be themselves,  why wait to die when u can die every sleep en wake up every day to this world .

I tell u spirit girls are so pure, pure in that what u see is what u get hence I find it hard to be in earthly romance,  I find myself seeking girls who are exact like those I meet there, this is how much spirit world will change ur life at minimum , material just can't compare with u just being there standing en doing nothing, no feeling can compare perhaps besides true pure love but unfortunately deep love becomes painful en our bodies can handle it if pass certain threshold. I tell u when there in right place en mindset u can stand in one place unmoving for billions of billions of years en u won't feel anything but content that's how great there is, yes the ugly is also as intense but that's more to do with identifying u with this human abilities en incapabilities including beliefs etc, then pain en suffering is guaranteed like its always has been.
